what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sudan in Australia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 360 Sudanese asylum seekers in Australia, 0.0% of all asylum seekers from Sudan.
Refugees from Sudan, a separate group, live mostly in Chad, South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan in periods from 1995 to 2025, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 15 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2018 and 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Australia only.
